steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bid-rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required counter-offer percentage configuration.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its responses and settings.
Reach the buyer's Responses view named in the case.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the RFQ settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order window is open.
Choose custom evaluation duration for the zero-value case.
Enter the specified zero duration in the field identified by placeholder 10.
Check whether the application refuses creation with a zero custom duration.
Verify the dialog remains open after the zero-value attempt.
Choose custom evaluation duration for the negative-value case.
Enter the specified negative duration.
Check whether the application refuses creation with a negative duration.
Verify the dialog remains open after the negative-value attempt.
Choose custom evaluation duration for the nonnumeric case.
Enter the specified alphabetic value.
Check whether the application refuses creation with a nonnumeric duration.
Verify the dialog remains open after the alphabetic-value attempt.
Choose custom evaluation duration for the very-large-value case.
Enter the specified very large duration.
Check whether the application refuses creation with the extremely large duration.
Verify the dialog remains open after the very-large-value attempt.
